title: Event Registration Automation
summary: Multi-path automation covering the full registration lifecycle with filtering, conditional routing, confirmation and reminder emails.
problem: Manual registration follow-up is slow and easy to get wrong.
objective: Handle registrations from submission to reminder without manual follow-up.
approach: Built a multi-path Zap in Zapier, using Filter by Zapier and Paths for conditional routing, with Google Forms, Google Sheets and Gmail.
process: Filtered and routed registrations by condition
impact: Removes manual follow-up from the registration process.
